notes.title: Development Log: 🦅 A Sacred Bond
notes.content:
🦅 Development Log: A Sacred Bond
For centuries, eagles and hawks have played an important role in hunting traditions around the world:

In Mongolia, golden eagles were trained to hunt foxes and hares in the harsh steppes.

In Turkey and Central Asia, falconry became a symbol of skill and status, passed down through generations.

For Indigenous tribes in North America, birds of prey were not only hunting partners but also sacred beings, guides, and a vital source of life.

These traditions were born out of the need to survive in unforgiving environments, but they also carried a spiritual meaning. The bond between hunter and bird represented trust, respect, and harmony with nature.

With the Eagle Companion, we want players to feel that same bond — not just a companion who fights by your side, but a true partner who helps you track, hunt, and survive.
With this special partner, you can:
Hunt small animals — for example, command your eagle to catch a snake and bring it back.

Take direct control of the eagle, using it almost like a drone.

Use its thermal vision to sense nearby dangers or spot wildlife.

The eagle is not just a visual companion; it will be a vital support in your struggle for survival.

notes.title: The Lost Hunter - DevLog
notes.content:
“Precision Guided Bullet” Mechanics
This feature is activated at the user's discretion after shooting a certain number of animals and allows free movement in a 45 degree circle using the mouse. 

Additional Information

 This mechanic is only activated using sniper weapons in the game.
 Acts in synchronization with the slow-motion bullet tracking mechanic.
 Activated at the user's request.
 After use, the counter is reset and the same number of animals must be hunted to activate the feature again


You can watch the video by clicking the Youtube link.
